list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and reported by Push Square at launch (18 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as published; every guide below is written in my own words and cites its source.
note: All 55 trophies are offline, single-player. There are no online trophies. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, one playthrough, free roam after the story but no mission replay. Do not use cheats on your trophy save: PowerPyx reports cheats disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.text: Do not use cheats on this save (they disable trophies and saving, per PowerPyx). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave, and there is no mission replay. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after the mission Down to Earth — it is the only trophy that may be missable (Positive Mental Attitude). Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide; Output Lag trophy list.
roadmap.title: Before you start — protect the one missable trophy

roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. All 12 story trophies unlock automatically as you play and none can be missed. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals through binoculars as you go — progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though it only becomes visible after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1–5

roadmap.text: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt with Bret, and complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count). These stay available in free roam after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
roadmap.title: Character quests and Strangers & Freaks

roadmap.text: Unlock jewelry robberies in Chapter 3 (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs), bank vaults in Chapter 4 (That's Where The Money Is…), then rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, and 3 shops back-to-back with your partner. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
roadmap.title: Robberies

roadmap.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets (of 18), scan 100 WAiNK locations, meditate at all 18 spots, finish 250 stunts, gold all 42 shooting range challenges, win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations, win 20 different races, complete 50 challenges and discover 100 vehicles. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist; Push Square trophy guide.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and activities

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is lenient — about 60% true completion, with most items asking for only part of a set (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets and meditations). Finish it for A Long Road (gold), clean up anything left, and Vice Got a Price! (platinum) pops. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist.
roadmap.title: The 100% checklist, then the platinum

PSQ.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops automatically. Nothing extra is needed: no multiplayer, no DLC and no online play, since the whole list is single-player and offline. PowerPyx rates the full run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, with one playthrough enough because free roam stays open after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to the end and it unlocks on completion. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 1; it pops when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 2; it pops when you start the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the final mission, Starting From Zero, to the end. Keep a manual save from just before it, since there is no mission replay — PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of every chapter. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just follow the story and it unlocks during the mission. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, but the checklist is forgiving. It only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% true completion: most items ask for only part of a set — 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets and meditations, 300 of 397 stunts. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it can be finished in free roam after the credits. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy. The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridges (fly under bridges), 40 knife flights (fly between buildings) and 25 base jumps (parachute). Mix them freely; PowerPyx says under-the-bridges are quickest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. Most come up naturally in the story and while clearing the 100% checklist, so PowerPyx expects this to pop on its own. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. There are two ranges in Leonida: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them on the map via Touchpad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Push Square lists the two ranges and the 42-challenge total; the 100% checklist needs the same 42 golds, so this and the checklist finish together. Sources: Push Square trophy guide; PowerPyx 100% checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total across them, per PowerPyx's drone-race guide). The 100% checklist needs every drone race too, so do them all rather than one per location. No confirmed per-location list was published by the cited sources at launch — use PowerPyx's Top Fun location guide for the individual spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so repeating the same race does not help. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations in the game, and the 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so keep racing past this trophy. Use PowerPyx's race-location guide to find fresh races you have not won yet. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text message marking a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in a fishing challenge. The questline opens early, so do it when the message arrives rather than leaving it for the endgame. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home with the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck, found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it — pick whichever you like best. You can already play the home games in Chapter 1. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and starts in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. Complete all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls you, then appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the treasure on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. After each set he calls you back for more. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. He goes temporarily unavailable during Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 — PowerPyx says calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds this up. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 of his quests — Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but not every side questline counts. PowerPyx confirms Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed to count are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being discovered, so check its Strangers & Freaks guide for the rest. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the list includes the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus and Tempesta, Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire and Banshee, and more. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can steal one anywhere off the street. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. It all stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is only available as Jason and starts after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After destroying enough labs Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. It all stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice (+2), so bring your partner — you can only do the final ones once both characters are playable together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The missable part: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That session is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx — who did it and then earned the trophy — says it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it to be safe and keep a Chapter 1 save. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this cannot block A Long Road either way. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% checklist; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is exclusive to Jason and starts after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret), in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100% completion. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so finish the whole Bret questline. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. The game holds 18 sets with 480 cards in total, and the 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets — so this trophy comes early on the way to the bigger goal. Track your cards under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards, and use PowerPyx's card-set location guide for the individual cards. Sources: PowerPyx 100% checklist; Push Square trophy guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it). Walk on foot near a scannable spot and you get an on-screen prompt; the spots are landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23), plus more, so any 100 will do. Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. The same 100 scans are needed for the 100% checklist. Sources: Push Square trophy guide; PowerPyx 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way — PowerPyx advises leaving it for last, then picking the easiest remaining ones. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom right shows when one is done. Many complete naturally while working on other trophies. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until it reaches 4 stars), then escape the red heat zone; the trophy pops after you drive out of the heat area, not just the flashing search area. PowerPyx's easiest route is a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also comes naturally later: bank vault robberies (Chapter 4) always trigger a 4-star wanted level. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, with your partner called in (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — stay in the red/blue flashing wanted state, not the red heat state. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and healing items. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not come, hit a 4th shop and keep going. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan): stand by a busy road and scan passing vehicles — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must take down 5 enemies in that one use, so prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, use Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them quickly without missing. PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) and grows by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots — by Focus Level 4 this is much easier. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not the planes sitting on the airfield; it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and by the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door straight into it. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. PowerPyx's guide to getting a tank covers the approach in detail. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies (marked with green icons in unfogged areas). Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm, so choose the stealth prompt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), marked automatically from story progress — it introduces bank vault robberies. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens; go in quickly and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After the quest, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 for security-van tips — do his earlier quests first if needed (robbing 2 Payday Loans) — and he marks vans with purple icons. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; this trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and a single bank can pay up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, find armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani becomes your fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx's guide to unfogging the map fast names the best plane for the job. No specific region list was published by the cited sources at launch, so use the in-game map itself as the checklist — any fog left means an area is still unexplored. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy pops. PowerPyx's guide shows the bar and the drink in screenshots. It is a one-off visit, available any time in free roam. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. Two conditions: you need the Key Cloner, unlocked in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), and it must be that specific blue Banshee — no other car works. The pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street. It is an easter egg referencing the Banshee from GTA III. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations — it comes up during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first, to blow the safe. The 3 items are: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the remaining valuables. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities, dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story. Always go together: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and while you actively train with one character, the other completes their training too, doubling progress. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that PowerPyx warns to avoid, since cops become more aggressive. Most players get this passively from robberies and fights on the way to 100%; if it is still missing at the end, PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — that is a guess, not a confirmed method, and no other cited source pins it down either. Do not chase a specific trick for it yet: the honest advice is to play the Payday Loans content when it comes up and check back once a guide confirms the unlock. This entry will say so plainly rather than invent a method. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (unknown at launch).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go solo. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops. If the car is not there, drive away and come back. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, matching the description — but that is a guess, not a confirmed method, and no other cited source pins it down either. The honest advice is to try melee kicks from a moving motorcycle against enemies and check back once a guide confirms it, rather than following an invented step-by-step. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (unknown at launch).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew): it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one delivery, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 per robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4. It comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — the total is cumulative, so every purchase counts. The fastest way is the most expensive goods: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so shop normally during the story and this will be close to done by the endgame. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count toward this trophy. Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses); you get a notification that a new phone app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. Register 10 vehicles — but first buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
